subject: Business Models
title: The Business Model Canvas
description: A fast breakdown of The Business Model Canvas for builders.

hook.text: Alexander Osterwalder turned business strategy into a one-page diagram. 5 million people have used his canvas.

buildup.text: The Business Model Canvas has 9 blocks: value proposition, customers, channels, revenue, costs, and more.

discovery.text: The canvas forces clarity: who pays, what they get, how it's delivered, and what it costs to operate.

twist.text: Most startups fill out a canvas once and never update it. The real value comes from iterating the model weekly.

climax.text: The canvas is a conversation tool, not a plan. Its power lies in quickly testing and comparing model alternatives.

punchline.text: 9 blocks, one page. The canvas maps how you make money.

quiz.question: How many building blocks does the Business Model Canvas have?
